name: Ranged Attack
description: A basic ranged attack.

name: Melee Attack
description: A basic melee strike.

name: Physical Resistance
description: Take Half damage from Physical attacks.

name: Battle Hardened
description: Battle-scarred discipline hardens the creature's defenses.

name: Iron Hide
description: Thick plating bolsters the creature's hide.

name: Bash
description: Bash a grappled creature into the ground.

save.failure: The target is knocked Prone.

name: Covering Fire
description: You loose a hail of arrows blanketing an area, potentially causing targets to bleed.

save.failure: The target gains the Bleeding condition.

effects.actionDescription: You mend the wounds of a creature within range.

name: Translocate
description: You disappear and reappear in a new space within 3 Spaces, navigating the Fey Plane.

effects.actionDescription: The area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute.

name: Umbral Blast
description: A magical AoE attack that deals Umbral and True damage.

name: Pack Instincts
description: The creature thrives when fighting alongside allies.

effects.text: Gain ADV on attack rolls when an ally is adjacent to the target.

name: Fishhook Shot
featureDescription: An attack that pulls the target toward the attacker.

effects.actionDescription: You fling out a hooked barb that strikes the target and attempt to pull them closer.

save.failure: Target is pulled toward you 2 Spaces.

name: Healing Burst
featureDescription: A healing effect targeting every creature around the caster.

effects.actionDescription: A burst of healing light shines around you, healing any creature it touches.
You teleport to a location of your choice within 4 Spaces.

name: Wing Blast
featureDescription: Push away creatures close to the user.

check.success: Push each target 1 Space directly away from you.

name: Whirlwind
featureDescription: A martial AoE attack hitting all adjacent creatures.

effects.actionDescription: You spin while wildly attacking in all directions.

name: Rallying Cry
featureDescription: Grant allies ADV on their next check.

effects.actionDescription: You yell out to your allies, granting them ADV on their next check.
You weave the arcane into a solid force that pushes the target 1 Space in any horizontal direction.

name: Charge
featureDescription: Required by other features. Charge up for a big move.

effects.actionDescription: You spend some time to charge up for a big move.
Requires Charge. A bright line of radiant light burns a path in front of you.

save.failure: Targets are Blinded until the end of your next round.

name: Stab and Run
featureDescription: Reaction: Attack and move when a hostile creature attacks you.
reactionTrigger: When a hostile creature makes an attack action within 1 Space of you

effects.actionDescription: After the attack you move up to your Speed without causing opportunity attacks.

name: Wall of Earth
featureDescription: Conjure a 4 Space long, 2 Space tall earthen wall.

effects.actionDescription: Conjure a 4 Space long, 2 Space tall wall of earth that fills an unoccupied area within 5 Spaces. The wall has PD 15, AD 15, 3 HP, and resistance 1 to Physical damage.
effects.target: a 4 Space line (2 Space tall wall)

name: Earth Spike
featureDescription: Ranged spell attack that conjures a spike of earth.

name: Gemantic Aura (3 Spaces)
description: You emanate an aura of control over earth within a 3 Space Aura.

effects.text: When you cast spells you can do so as if you were standing in any Space over earth in your Aura, and any creature within your Aura has DisADV on Saves against you.

name: Earth Walker
description: You're not affected by Difficult Terrain created by rock, dirt, mud, or sand.

effects.text: Ignore Difficult Terrain created by rock, dirt, mud, or sand.

name: Relentless
description: This creature refuses to fall.

effects.text: When reduced to 0 HP for the first time in combat, you instead drop to 1 HP. This effect can only occur once per encounter.

name: Bone Crusher
description: Grappled foes are crushed mercilessly.

effects.text: Creatures you Grapple take 2 Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of your turns.

name: Heavy Strike
description: A devastating overhead blow that can topple even sturdy opponents.

effects.actionDescription: You bring down a crushing blow with all your might.

save.failure: The target is knocked Prone.

name: Lunge
description: Charge forward and drive your weapon into your foe.

effects.range: 3 Spaces (must move at least 2 Spaces toward target first)
effects.actionDescription: You surge forward, adding momentum to your strike.

name: Tremor Strike
description: Slam the ground, sending shockwaves through the earth.

effects.actionDescription: You drive your fist or weapon into the ground, sending a shockwave rippling outward.

save.failure: The target is knocked Prone.

name: Grapple
description: Seize and hold a creature in place.

effects.actionDescription: You reach out and attempt to seize the target.

check.successEach5: Extend the Grapple's effective range by 1 Space.

name: War Cry
description: A terrifying battle cry that shakes the resolve of your enemies.

effects.actionDescription: You unleash a thunderous roar. Each creature you target must make a Cha Save or become Frightened of you until the end of your next turn.

name: Haymaker Throw
description: Hurl a Grappled creature into another target.

effects.actionDescription: You hurl a Grappled creature up to 3 Spaces. If it collides with another creature, both take Bludgeoning damage equal to your base damage. Requires: Grapple.

name: Body Block
description: Throw yourself in the path of an attack targeting an ally.
reactionTrigger: When an ally within 1 Space of you is targeted by an attack

effects.actionDescription: You shove your ally aside and become the target of the triggering attack instead.

name: Sharpshooter
description: Precise aim cuts through cover and leaves lasting wounds.

effects.text: Your ranged attacks ignore cover bonuses to PD and AD. When your ranged attack deals damage, the target gains the Bleeding condition.

name: Sniper Shot
description: A precise shot aimed at exposed weak points from long distance.

effects.actionDescription: You line up a perfect shot. You must not have moved this turn.

name: Explosive Arrow
description: An arrow tipped with a volatile substance that detonates on impact.

effects.actionDescription: You fire an arrow that explodes on impact in a burst of fire and shrapnel.

save.failure: The target gains the Burning condition.

name: Chain Shot
description: A weighted shot that passes through multiple enemies in a line.

effects.target: up to 2 creatures in a line
effects.actionDescription: You fire a spinning chain shot that tears through enemies in a straight path.

name: Suppressive Fire
description: Lay down a hail of fire to pin enemies in place.

effects.actionDescription: You flood an area with projectiles. The area becomes Difficult Terrain until the start of your next turn. Creatures moving through it make an Agi Save or become Hindered.

check.success: The area is Difficult Terrain and creatures moving through it make an Agi Save or become Hindered.

name: Smoke Arrow
description: Fire an arrow that bursts into concealing smoke on impact.

effects.actionDescription: You fire a smoke arrow that erupts into a thick cloud. The area is Heavily Obscured until the start of your next turn.

name: Scatter Caltrops
description: Scatter spiked caltrops across the battlefield.

effects.actionDescription: You scatter caltrops in the area. It becomes Difficult Terrain. Any creature that enters the area for the first time on its turn takes 1 Piercing damage.

name: Aura of Dread
description: The creature exudes an aura of supernatural terror.

effects.text: Creatures that start their turn within 3 Spaces of you must make a Cha Save or become Frightened of you until the start of their next turn.

name: Lingering Curse
description: Failed saves leave lingering marks on the target.

effects.text: When a creature fails a Save against one of your effects, it has DisADV on its next Save against your effects.

name: Mindbreak
description: A focused psychic assault that overloads the target's mind.

effects.actionDescription: You unleash a bolt of psychic energy that shatters concentration.

save.failure: The target is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

name: Gravity Well
description: Create a gravitational anomaly that drags creatures toward a point.

effects.actionDescription: You create a crushing gravitational field. Each creature in the area makes a Mig Save or is pulled 2 Spaces toward the center and becomes Hindered until the end of its next turn.

check.success: Affect all creatures in the area.

name: Frost Nova
description: An explosion of freezing energy that encases nearby enemies in ice.

effects.actionDescription: A burst of intense cold erupts from you, freezing everything nearby.

save.failure: The target gains the Slowed condition until the end of its next turn.

name: Mass Confusion
description: Scramble the senses of multiple creatures at once.

effects.actionDescription: You flood the minds of your targets with disorienting illusions. Each target makes an Int Save or becomes Disoriented until the end of its next turn.

name: Guardian Stance
description: The creature's presence bolsters nearby allies.

effects.text: Allies within 1 Space of you gain +1 to PD and AD.

name: Stalwart
description: This creature cannot be easily moved or shaken.

effects.text: You cannot be knocked Prone or moved against your will by non-magical means. When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may make a free melee attack against it as a Reaction.

name: Shield Slam
description: Smash into a foe with your shield, knocking them off balance.

effects.actionDescription: You drive your shield into the target with crushing force.

save.failure: The target is knocked Prone and pushed 1 Space directly away from you.

name: Sweeping Guard
description: A wide arc attack that punishes all creatures within reach.

effects.actionDescription: You sweep your weapon in a wide arc, striking all who approach.

name: Retributive Strike
description: Strike back when an ally near you is attacked.
reactionTrigger: When a creature within 1 Space of you deals damage to an ally

effects.actionDescription: You immediately lash back at any creature that strikes your allies.

name: Taunt Strike
description: A calculated blow meant to draw the enemy's focus.

effects.actionDescription: You strike the target with a goading blow, forcing their attention onto you.

save.failure: The target gains the Taunted condition, targeting only you with its next attack.

name: Interpose
description: Throw yourself between an attack and an ally.
reactionTrigger: When an ally within 1 Space of you is targeted by an attack

effects.actionDescription: You step into the path of the attack, becoming the target instead. The attack targets your PD or AD (same defense as originally targeted).

name: Fortress Stance
description: Plant your feet and become an immovable wall.

effects.actionDescription: Until the start of your next turn, you gain +3 PD and AD, but your Speed becomes 0. You also cannot be moved or knocked Prone.

name: Ambush Predator
description: The creature excels at striking from concealment.

effects.text: Your attacks deal +3 damage against creatures that have not yet acted in combat or that are unaware of you.

name: Shadow Step
description: This creature flickers between patches of shadow with supernatural ease.

effects.text: Once per turn, when you move through dim light or darkness, you may attempt to Hide as part of that movement.

name: Backstab
description: Drive a blade into an exposed flank for devastating effect.

effects.actionDescription: You find an opening and drive your weapon deep. This attack has ADV if you are Hidden from the target or if an ally is adjacent to it.

name: Garrote
description: Loop a cord around the target's neck and choke.

effects.actionDescription: You seize the target from behind. On a hit, the target is Grappled. While Grappled this way, the target makes an Agi Save at the end of each of its turns or becomes Incapacitated.

save.failure: The target is Grappled.

name: Poison Strike
description: A swift strike coated in potent toxin.

effects.actionDescription: You strike quickly with a venomous weapon.

save.failure: The target gains the Poisoned condition.

name: Shadow Pounce
description: Leap from the shadows and slam into your prey.

effects.actionDescription: You emerge from concealment in a deadly leap. You move up to 4 Spaces toward the target as part of this action.

save.failure: The target is knocked Prone and Dazed until end of its next turn.

name: Smoke Cloud
description: Conjure a thick cloud of smoke to obscure the battlefield.

effects.actionDescription: You create a cloud of dense smoke. The area is Heavily Obscured until the start of your next turn.

name: Shadow Meld
description: Merge with nearby shadows, becoming impossible to see.

effects.actionDescription: You step into a shadow and become Invisible until the start of your next turn or until you make an attack or cast a spell.

name: Aura of Vitality
description: This creature's presence accelerates the healing of nearby allies.

effects.text: Allies that start their turn within 2 Spaces of you regain 1 HP.

name: Inspiring Presence
description: The creature's courage shores up the resolve of nearby allies.

effects.text: Allies within 2 Spaces of you have ADV on Saves against the Frightened and Charmed conditions.

name: Holy Smite
description: Channel divine radiance into a searing bolt of light.

effects.actionDescription: You hurl a bolt of holy light at your enemy. Against Undead and Fiends, this attack deals +2 additional Radiant damage.

name: Binding Bolt
description: A crackling bolt of energy that locks the target in place.

effects.actionDescription: You hurl a bolt of crackling binding energy.

save.failure: The target is Restrained until the end of its next turn.

name: Sacred Flame
description: A burst of divine fire that purges corruption from a wide area.

effects.actionDescription: Divine flames erupt in a sphere, burning all enemies within.

save.failure: The target is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Bless
description: Call down divine favor on your allies.

effects.actionDescription: You invoke divine blessing on your allies. Each target gains ADV on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.

name: Divine Shield
description: Cloak an ally in protective divine energy.

effects.actionDescription: You weave a divine barrier around an ally. The target gains +3 PD and AD until the start of your next turn.

name: Undying
description: This creature refuses to stay dead.

effects.text: When reduced to 0 HP for the first time in combat, this creature instead drops to 1 HP. This effect can only occur once per encounter. The creature must be fully destroyed (reduced to 0 HP a second time) to be permanently slain.

name: Undead Resilience
description: The creature's undead nature grants immunity to certain afflictions.

name: Life Drain
description: Drain the vital essence from a creature to fuel your own unlife.

effects.actionDescription: You reach out and draw the life force from your target. You regain HP equal to the damage dealt.

name: Terrifying Visage
description: Reveal your true undead nature to strike terror into the living.

effects.actionDescription: You unveil the horror of your undead form. Each living creature in range must make a Cha Save or become Frightened of you until the end of its next turn.

check.successEach5: Affected creatures are Frightened for 1 minute instead.

name: Necrotic Aura
description: Death radiates from this creature's form.

effects.text: Creatures that start their turn within 2 Spaces of you take 1 Necrotic damage.

name: Frightful Presence
description: The dragon's sheer presence terrifies lesser creatures.

effects.text: Any creature that starts its turn within 5 Spaces of you that is aware of you must make a Cha Save or become Frightened of you until the start of its next turn. A creature that succeeds is immune to this effect for 24 hours.

name: Dragon Scales
description: Thick draconic scales provide exceptional natural armor.

name: Fire Breath
description: Unleash a devastating cone of scorching dragonfire.

effects.actionDescription: You exhale a torrent of fire from your jaws.

save.failure: The target gains the Burning condition.

name: Claw Rake
description: Tear through a target with both claws in a raking strike.

effects.actionDescription: You slash across your target twice in quick succession.

name: Wing Sweep
description: Beat your massive wings to scatter nearby creatures.

effects.actionDescription: You beat your wings in a powerful sweep. Each creature in range makes a Mig Save or is pushed 3 Spaces directly away from you and knocked Prone.

name: Infernal Resilience
description: Born of hellfire, this creature shrugs off flame and poison.

name: Dark Pact
description: Striking this creature is a dangerous bargain.

effects.text: Whenever a creature deals damage to you, it takes 1 Fire damage.

name: Hellfire Bolt
description: Hurl a bolt of crackling hellfire at a distant foe.

effects.actionDescription: You hurl a bolt of infernal flame.

save.failure: The target gains the Burning condition.

name: Hellfire Burst
description: Summon a pillar of infernal fire to immolate an area.

effects.actionDescription: A column of hellfire erupts from the ground, scorching everything within.

save.failure: The target gains the Burning condition.

name: Infernal Gaze
description: Lock eyes with a creature and overwhelm their will.

effects.actionDescription: You fix your infernal gaze upon a creature. It makes a Cha Save or becomes Charmed by you until the end of its next turn. While Charmed this way, it regards you as a trusted ally.

check.success: The target is Charmed until the end of its next turn.
check.successEach5: The Charmed duration increases by 1 round.

name: Thick Hide
description: Dense fur, scales, or chitinous plating absorbs punishment.

name: Pack Hunter
description: This creature coordinates with its packmates to bring down prey.

effects.text: When you make an attack against a creature that has an ally of yours adjacent to it, you deal +2 damage.

name: Pounce
description: Leap onto your prey, bearing them to the ground.

effects.range: 3 Spaces (must move at least 2 Spaces toward target first)
effects.actionDescription: You leap at your target and crash into them with your full weight.

save.failure: The target is knocked Prone.

name: Venomous Bite
description: Sink venomous fangs into the target.

effects.actionDescription: You sink your fangs into the target, injecting venom.

save.failure: The target gains the Poisoned condition.

name: Fierce Roar
description: Let out a thunderous roar to shake nearby enemies.

effects.actionDescription: You unleash a bone-shaking roar. Creatures in range make a Cha Save or become Frightened until the end of their next turn.

check.successEach5: Affected creatures are Frightened for 1 additional round.

name: Aberrant Resilience
description: The creature's alien biology resists mental manipulation.

name: Psychic Aura
description: This creature's alien mind bleeds into the thoughts of those nearby.

effects.text: Creatures within 2 Spaces of you that take damage must make an Int Save or become Disoriented until the start of their next turn.

name: Mind Blast
description: Project a psychic shockwave that staggers all who feel it.

effects.actionDescription: You project a devastating wave of psychic energy from your mind.

save.failure: The target is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

name: Tentacle Grab
description: Lash out with a powerful tentacle to restrain prey.

effects.actionDescription: You whip a tentacle toward a creature, attempting to wrap it up.

save.failure: The target is Restrained. It can free itself with a DC 12 Mig Check on its turn.

name: Void Gaze
description: Fix your unfathomable gaze on a creature, filling them with existential dread.

effects.actionDescription: You fix your alien gaze upon a creature. It makes an Int Save or becomes Frightened and Disoriented until the end of its next turn.

check.success: Target is Frightened and Disoriented until end of its next turn.
check.successEach5: The target is also Stunned for 1 round.

name: Plant Resilience
description: The creature's plant nature grants unusual resistances.

name: Photosynthesis
description: This creature draws strength from natural light.

effects.text: While in sunlight or bright natural light, you regain 1 HP at the start of each of your turns.

name: Vine Grapple
description: Shoot out binding vines to entangle a target.

effects.actionDescription: You launch a bundle of fast-growing vines toward your target.

save.failure: The target is Restrained until the end of its next turn.
save.failureEach5: The Restrained duration increases by 1 round.

name: Thorn Lash
description: Whip a barbed vine at a creature, tearing through flesh.

effects.actionDescription: You lash out with a thorned vine, raking across the target.

save.failure: The target gains the Bleeding condition.

name: Spore Cloud
description: Release a cloud of toxic spores to sicken nearby creatures.

effects.actionDescription: You release a burst of toxic spores. The area becomes Heavily Obscured and Difficult Terrain. Creatures that start their turn in the area make a Mig Save or gain the Poisoned condition.
